comment: Global per-asset rarity control for the ALWAYS-PRESENT traits (eyes, mouths, backgrounds). Optional traits -- arms, footwear, stickers -- and the legendary plates and secret rares get EXACT counts from asset_assessment/build_mint.py instead, because a trait that is either present or absent can be slot-allocated exactly. An always-present trait cannot: it has to compose with the compat blocklists, so it is drawn by weight and calibrated. 'target' is the intended share of the mint in percent. 'gain' is the draw multiplier the generator actually uses, solved by asset_assessment/calibrate_rarity.py so the REALISED share matches the target -- they differ wherever a hard block distorts the draw, most of all for the Blue eye, which eyez_compat bars from 42% of plates.

backgroundz.comment: Three tiers below the four Legendary plates, which are slot-allocated at exactly 50 each and never appear in the weighted pick. Rare ~0.6% each, uncommon ~1.1%, everything unlisted shares the rest.

optional.comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the optional traits (arms, footwear, sticker). build_mint.py slot-allocates these EXACT counts; generator.py derives its per-token roll rates from the same numbers, so an ad-hoc render is a real sample of the mint. These used to be declared twice -- exact counts here, independent rates in generator -- and they silently disagreed: sheets showed arms at 34.7% against a mint of 15.9%. asset_assessment/verify_generator_rules.py now fails if the two drift apart again.
optional.footwear_availability_comment: Divisor for the footwear roll, NOT a literal availability share. Footwear is only offered to characters that can wear it, so the roll rate is scaled up to still land on the mint's overall share. CALIBRATED BY MEASUREMENT, not derived: the narrow count (is_wat_excluded over the cast) gives 0.553, but gorbhouse reaches some excluded characters. 0.591 was a first estimate and undershot -- averaged over six seeds x 3000 tokens it realised 11.40% against a target of 11.99%, so it is scaled by 11.40/11.99 to 0.562. Re-measure with verify_generator_rules.py if the cast or CHARACTER_COUNTS change; a single seed is not enough to judge it, the seed-to-seed stdev is 0.65 points at n=3000.
